Build each package's JavaScript with bun build

The executor wants siblings consumed through their build instead of
workspace:* pointing at source. The build so far emitted only types:
2956 .d.ts and no .js in the 48 dist/ directories, and every export's
default resolved to a .ts file.

build_javascript.py emits a .js next to each .d.ts with the same root
the declarations use, and repoints default and main to dist while the
@thyrox/source condition keeps the source reachable. It uses
--splitting because without it two entries that share a stateful module
each get their own copy; the suite proves this with a shared counter.
bunfig.toml has no key for export conditions (read from the Bun 1.3.11
strings: the conditions check sits with the Bun.build options), so
reading source needs --conditions on every command.

emit_declarations now takes the source from @thyrox/source and keeps a
default that already points at dist/*.js; before, emitting types would
have undone the JavaScript repoint. Dropping --splitting or that guard
fails exactly the tests that depend on each.
